info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Sale Commission Agreement-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of Sale Commission Agreements, enabling businesses to formalize commission structures for sales performances. By utilizing this interface, users can efficiently define and manage agreements that outline the terms and conditions between sales teams and business entities. Typical consumers of this API include sales managers and finance teams looking to streamline commission processing and improve payment accuracy. This endpoint plays a vital role in ensuring that all commission-related transactions are governed by formal and clear agreements.

post.summary: Create a new sales commission agreement.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to establish a new sales commission agreement, detailing the terms and conditions governing the sales commissions for agents or representatives. Ensure to provide all necessary fields in the request body for successful creation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new commission agreement within the sales module. It should contain the relevant details regarding the commission structure and associated terms.

201.description: The commission agreement was successfully created.
